raw_record.summary: Generate and edit diagrams with the mcp-diagram-generator MCP server. Use this skill for new diagrams, existing .drawio/.mmd/.excalidraw edits, network topology, architecture, flowchart, swimlane, sequence, class, ER, and Excalidraw whiteboard work. Always use this skill when the user asks to draw,
